domains.description: Experimental mgbrowser CDP subset. This schema describes only implemented research-browser behavior, not Chrome or full CDP compatibility.

commands.name: getVersion
commands.description: Report mgbrowser identity and the bundled experimental interpreter version. This does not imply scripting is enabled or full Runtime compatibility.

domains.description: Bounded synchronous main-world execution in the existing restricted page worker. Requires debugging, enabled page scripts and accepted LoadComplete. No promise awaiting, utility worlds, activation, previews or full upstream exception schema. See RUNTIME_AUTOMATION.md for admissions and lifetime rules.

types.description: Opaque context/route-owner/worker-root identity; foreign, stale and forged IDs reject.

properties.name: unserializableValue
properties.description: NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, -0 or canonical bounded decimal BigInt followed by n.

types.description: At most one form; an empty object means undefined. Objects by value are bounded ordinary JSON trees, not arbitrary structured clone.
Complete own descriptors only. Accessors are rooted, never invoked; symbol keys and unsupported exotics reject without a partial list.

Deliberately narrowed, not the full upstream required shape. Unknown line/column/source/stack fields are omitted. An unrepresentable thrown value omits exception and the command result instead of inventing thrown undefined. Runtime catches do not dispatch page onerror.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Acknowledge before reporting existing contexts. Notifications alone grant no scripting permission or worker credit.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disable notifications only; explicitly release roots or detach/disconnect for cleanup.

commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: Evaluate at most 16 KiB in the actual retained main world. Optional semantic booleans other than returnByValue accept false only. An ordinary caught exception returns exceptionDetails; unsupported representation is a protocol error with real preceding DOM effects retained.

returns.name: result
returns.description: Absent only when the caught thrown value cannot be represented; see ExceptionDetails.

commands.name: callFunctionOn
commands.description: Compile and invoke the supplied function with native guarded receiver/argument identity. Specify objectId or executionContextId, not both; omit both to use the actual realm global. Missing objectGroup inherits the receiver group. Semantic booleans other than returnByValue accept false only.

commands.name: getProperties
commands.description: Require ownProperties:true; other optional booleans accept false only. Maximum64 complete descriptors; no getters, proxy traps or checkpoint execution.

commands.name: releaseObject
commands.description: Drop an actual owned root; same-owner duplicate release is idempotent. No cumulative accounting refund.

commands.name: releaseObjectGroup
commands.description: Release this route owner's named group only. No JavaScript or checkpoint; native edits remain pending.

domains.description: Stable targets for existing native tabs, including inactive tabs. Browser connections can attach using flattened sessions; no auto-attach, target mutation commands, workers, or browser contexts.

commands.name: getTargets
commands.description: Return all current native page targets; target filters are unsupported. Moving a tab preserves its target ID; closed IDs are never reused.

commands.name: getTargetInfo
commands.description: Return the specified target or the direct/attached page. An unattached browser connection with zero or multiple pages must specify targetId.

commands.name: attachToTarget
commands.description: Attach to an existing page target. This subset requires flatten=true; nested message sessions are unsupported.

events.name: detachedFromTarget
events.description: Emitted on explicit session detach or when the native tab closes. Pending navigation replies fail and detached sessions never retarget another tab.

domains.description: Single-frame navigation and software-rendered viewport inspection. Browser toolbar and status strip are excluded. CSS geometry stays logical; screenshots use the selected physical display scale.

types.description: Core committed-frame metadata for the sole top-level frame; experimental Chrome security and isolation metadata is not supplied.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Committed document URL without its fragment.

properties.name: urlFragment
properties.description: Fragment including the leading #, when present.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enable Page notifications for this connection or session.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disable Page notifications for this connection or session.

commands.name: navigate
commands.description: Navigate to an absolute HTTP(S) URL of at most 16 KiB. The response waits for initial load completion, not arbitrary timer/queue idle; transport, infrastructure, modern terminal initial-script failure and supersession produce errorText without fabricating missing worker lifecycle events. The explicit legacy v1 test lane preserves parent-owned completion for a delivered document with a validated failed script, retaining its failure outcome and readable fallback. frameId, when present, must identify this target's top-level frame-N (frame-1 for page-1).

commands.name: reload
commands.description: Reload using existing browser navigation. No script injection or cache implementation is provided.

commands.name: getLayoutMetrics
commands.description: Logical CSS viewport geometry and deprecated device-pixel fields scaled to the current display size. Visual scale/zoom remain one; separate pinch/page-only zoom is not implemented.

commands.name: captureScreenshot
commands.description: Return a base64 PNG of the current page viewport at physical display resolution. format defaults to png; other codecs, clip, and captureBeyondViewport=true are unsupported. Both fromSurface values use the same software raster. No requested rescaling or full-page capture. Encoded output is limited to 7 MiB.

domains.description: Inspection of mgbrowser's actual bounded HTML tree. Selectors are a declared subset. Node references are invalidated by document replacement or accepted script projection. DOM node-handle arguments cannot use Runtime object IDs; no resolveNode/requestNode bridge.

types.description: Eight values describing four x,y corners.

commands.name: getDocument
commands.description: Read the parser tree and enable documentUpdated events. depth defaults to one, accepts 0..256, and -1 requests the bounded subtree. pierce=true is unsupported. Serialized root is limited to 4 MiB.

commands.name: querySelector
commands.description: Query the supported selector subset within the requested node. A missing match returns nodeId zero.

commands.name: getBoxModel
commands.description: Union of this node's own or descendant flow boxes, with viewport intersection required. The four model quads are currently equal and may extend outside the viewport. Wholly offscreen/non-rendered nodes, layout collections reaching 100000 rectangles, and queries exceeding four million traversal steps return an error without a partial model. This is not a full CSS box model.

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Focus an editable control represented by nodeId. Other node-handle forms are unsupported.

events.name: documentUpdated
events.description: Document replaced or script-event projection accepted; discard previous nodeId references and request the new root.

domains.description: Input for the existing page controls, using logical CSS viewport coordinates independent of display size. A scale or viewport resize cancels pending presses. With opt-in scripting, activation dispatches bounded retained click/submit handlers. No touch, drag, IME composition, synthetic script dispatch, or general keyboard/input event support.

commands.name: dispatchMouseEvent
commands.description: Basic left click and vertical wheel input within the page viewport. Press/release require button:left; buttons and clickCount are limited to 0 or 1, modifiers to zero, deltaX to zero, and absolute deltaY to at most 100000. A release within five pixels of its session's press activates once. Mouse movement has no hover/drag behavior.

commands.name: dispatchKeyEvent
commands.description: Page keys: Enter, Backspace, Tab, PageUp/Down, ArrowUp/Down, Shift, Control, or one character. Only Ctrl=2 and Shift=8 modifier bits are supported, and Ctrl+A is the sole control shortcut. windowsVirtualKeyCode fallback handles 13, 8, and 9; code, nativeVirtualKeyCode, unmodifiedText, and autoRepeat are validated metadata, not alternative key translation. Editing-command arrays are unsupported. Text insertion requires focused input, printable text, and a resulting value of at most 8191 UTF-8 bytes; rejection preserves the value and selection. rawKeyDown does not insert printable text, and keyUp has no edit action.

commands.name: insertText
commands.description: Insert printable UTF-8 text into the focused editable page control. The resulting value must be at most 8191 UTF-8 bytes, accounting for selected text replacement. Invalid text or excess size returns an error without changing value or selection.
